name: SiteSuperCharger
author: AnAdminer

sections.description:
SiteSuperCharger helps your website look as attractive as possible to search engines helping you to acheive the highest search engine rankings.

Contact Marketing Heroes (https://www.mheroes.com) to get started!
sections.installation:
Install SiteSuperCharger via the plugin directory, or by uploading the files manually to your server. After activating SiteSuperCharger, you’ll need to enter your GUID at Settings -> SiteSuperCharger

For info about acquiring a GUID for SiteSuperCharger visit https://www.mheroes.com.
sections.faq:
Is SiteSuperCharger free?

You must purchase Search Engine Optimization services from Marketing Heroes (https://www.mheroes.com) to use SiteSuperCharger

5.4.24

Release date: Apr 17th, 2026

  • Stronger monotonic progress bars — bars stay stable across the full rebuild.
  • Reordered maintenance actions for better workflow.
  • Cleaner status + alert wording; thousands separators on large counts.

5.4.23

Release date: Apr 17th, 2026

Release date: Apr 17th, 2026

  • Content counts use thousands separators.
  • Clearer wording on the missing-SEO-data help panel.

5.4.21

Release date: Apr 17th, 2026

  • New: on-demand plugin update check + 1-click install from settings page.
  • Improved duplicate cleanup UX — cleanup only appears when duplicates exist.
  • Clearer wording for missing-SEO-data alerts with actionable next steps.

  • Reduced repeated background calls when remote settings are unavailable.
